title: Comprehensive Eye Exam
definition: The dilated eye exam — vision, pressure, lens, retina — catches glaucoma, macular degeneration, and diabetic disease early. Annual exams after 60. The eyes reveal systemic health too.
patient_flow: Eye exams start with vision testing, pressure checks, and dilated retinal exams; OCT and fields quantify disease. Medical management (drops, injections) runs through clinics; surgical days handle cataracts, retinas, and glaucomas with microscopic precision. Emergency eye trauma gets immediate surgery; low vision rehab maximizes remaining sight.
code_demo:
def snellen_to_logmar(num, den=20):
    """Converts Snellen fraction to logMAR for tracking vision change."""
    import math
    logmar = round(-math.log10(num / den), 2)
    band = "normal" if logmar <= 0.0 else "mild loss" if logmar <= 0.3 else "moderate loss" if logmar <= 1.0 else "severe loss"
    return f"{num}/{den} = {logmar} logMAR ({band})"
print(snellen_to_logmar(20, 200))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
